title: The next outbreak? We’re not ready | Bill Gates | TED
summary: Bill Gates's 2015 TED talk, given after the 2014 Ebola outbreak, argues the world is unprepared for the next fast-spreading epidemic. He calls for scenario planning, vaccine research, and trained health workers, in the way countries prepare for war.
why: During COVID-19 HN commenters cited it as a prescient pandemic warning.

quote.text: It's impressive how the details are similar to coronavirus.
